framework.recency_definition: days from the customer's last valid purchase date to the cutoff date (0 = purchased on cutoff day)
framework.frequency_definition: number of distinct valid invoices on or before the cutoff
framework.monetary_definition: sum of Quantity x UnitPrice over valid product lines on or before the cutoff (GBP)
framework.outcome_definition: outcome_inactive = 1 if the customer has no valid purchase in the observation window
